newsitem.title: USA: Beverly to sell some Texas nursing homes.
newsitem.headline: Beverly to sell some Texas nursing homes.

text.p: Beverly Enterprises Inc said on Thursday it has agreed to sell its skilled nursing facilities in Texas to Complete Care Services LP for an undisclosed price.
The transaction covers 43 facilities Beverly owns as well as six more facilities currently operated by Beverly under long-term leases, Beverly said.
It is expected to close during the second quarter, and is subject to normal regulatory review.
The 49 Texas facilities, which account for 6,061 beds, generated profitable revenues of approximately $150 million in 1996, the company said.
Beverly previously had announced its intention to sell them because the facilities were not strategically located in markets where other Beverly operations are clustered, the company said.
Proceeds of the sale will be available for strategic investment, debt repayment and stock repurchase, Beverly said.
Complete Care Services, based in Horsham, Pa., is a privately-held owner and manager of long-term care facilities, Beverly said.
